'''Kursil''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] present at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], immediately before the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]]. Alongside [[Alara]], [[Bynin]], [[Ceras]] and others, he fell during the fighting.
